title: UNISFA stewardship of MINUSMA-transferred and underused assets
decision_reason: Retained governing-text extraction identifies a review/control mechanism; underlying complete operational records, accountable owner confirmation and financial validation are absent.
current_arrangement: Retained A/RES/80/275 paragraphs 10–11 requests underutilized asset assessment and accountable management of MINUSMA transfers; paragraphs 12 and 15 protect security and fleet capability. Serial-level transfer and utilization records are absent.
testable_mechanism: Test whether usable transferred items can meet approved demand and avoid an otherwise necessary acquisition, or whether underuse reflects condition, access, maintenance or a justified readiness reserve.
feasible_alternative_to_test: Repair, reassign or dispose of individually assessed assets under approved authority; retain justified operational reserves and protective capacity.
safeguards: Counter-UAS and personnel protection within mandate
Safe accountable custody and authorized disposal
cost_perimeter_and_nonadditivity: Assess each serial over remaining service life. Carrying value and donor write-off are accounting transfers, not cash benefits. Net any avoidable external purchase against transport, storage, repair, spares, insurance and disposal proceeds; do not overlap the translation case or general mission budget.
minimum_records: Donor MINUSMA release and UNISFA signed receipt with serial IDs and dates
Inventory/GL postings, ownership, condition, location and remaining life
Utilization logs, downtime, maintenance invoices and reserve rationale
Approved recipient demand, canceled requisition/PO and net transfer lifecycle costs
custodian_roles_to_confirm: UNISFA property management and fleet engineering
UNISFA procurement, finance and security planners

source_snapshot.directive_paraphrase: Assess underutilized assets promptly and report on increased utilization
Ensure systematic and accountable management of assets transferred from MINUSMA
Improve counter-UAS capability within mandate while reducing security losses
Provide information on measures sustaining operational vehicle fleet

source_snapshot.decision_guardrail: The GA inclusive appropriation includes shared support UNLB and RSCE; adopted_minus_proposed compares GA mission-maintenance gross against SG mission-maintenance gross; no new savings inferred

case_specific_limit: Low observed use alone would not establish avoidable cost: mission security, seasonality and serviceability can require reserve assets.
source_review_scope: Retained repository extractions; primary resolution bytes are not newly authenticated and no current implementation or compliance determination is made.
handling: Use approved restricted intake, minimum necessary fields and pseudonymization; no live financial, personnel, medical or security-sensitive records in this public repository.
reopen_condition: Confirmed accountable owner and authorized complete linked records permit a validation-ready assessment; a draft request is not authority or evidence receipt.
